answer_pipeline.correction_semantics: the correction overwrites the memory slot for the last answered question; the corrected answer is then served at step 5, before built-in facts, permanently (persisted in rocket-brain.json)

dispatch_order.rule: if the message starts with a correction prefix, it permanently fixes the last answered fact and returns immediately
exact match on more/another/next/another tip/next tip/tell me more/more tips fires another tip on the previous topic
greetings, jokes, thanks, identity questions answered conversationally
personal facts are learned: my name is / my favorite game is / add game <name> / skill level / loadout context
taught + corrected answers matched FIRST over the knowledge base
curated knowledge pack of the selected game, then universal item brain, then generic topic brain; if nothing matches Rocket asks to be taught

edge_cases: a normal question that merely contains the word 'wrong' is NOT treated as a correction (tested: normal_questions_containing_wrong_are_not_corrections)
'wrong:' with no prior answered question explains how corrections work instead of failing (tested: correction_without_question_explains)
corrections always beat learned answers at recall (tested: corrections_overwrite_last_answer)

tree_atelier.completion: node criteria are event counters (grounded answers per discipline, teach events, ordeal runs, comparative realm answers); sealing a node pays its XP through the global economy; sealing all required nodes pays a 10% tree bonus
desk_commands: (Create Tree button → guided interrogation: game → shape → generated graph)
tree_atelier.feature: CREATE TREE — multi-instance quest-tree authoring environment
tree_atelier.graph_ui: interactive canvas: circular nodes (❓ available / ✓ sealed / · locked), automatic tier-column layout, edges glow+pulse when their source seals, click-to-select with synchronized detail panel and Mark Done (frontier-only; locked nodes explain prerequisites in character)
tree_atelier.node_traceability: every node's grimoire_sections are validated against the live knowledge base; stale nodes are flagged and repairable

xp_model.note: bonuses are added on top of the standard conversation XP (memory.rs)

kind_triggers.explore: switching to a different game in one day
kind_triggers.item: asking how to get any item/gear

pool.title: Ask how to get any item or gear

daily_quests.progress_rule: quest_progress(kind, n) advances every active quest of that kind; progress clamps at target; completion pays xp_reward immediately via add_experience
daily_quests.reroll_rule: rerolled when the stored quest_day differs from today's local date (YYYY-MM-DD); games_today is cleared on reroll
daily_quests.roll_algorithm: Fisher-Yates shuffle of the full pool, take first 3 (distinct by construction)

game_detection.platform: Windows (tasklist CSV); other platforms return none and manual selection still works

answer_sources.CrossGame: another game's pack — only in General Chat mode
answer_sources.Game: curated guide from the currently selected game's pack (+ its first tag)
answer_sources.UniversalItem: universal 'how to get X' brain for any item in any game

per_game.game: Ori and the Will of the Wisps

search_rules: substring match counts; a token also matches when it is a prefix of the tag or the tag is a prefix of the token and BOTH sides are >= 4 chars (so 'netherite' hits 'nether', 'diamonds' hits 'diamond')
search(game, q, limit) only returns that game's entries; search_any(q, limit) crosses games and is used in General Chat mode only
a selected game NEVER returns another game's pack entries (tested in game_qa)

coins_rule.note: spending coins never reduces level or level progress; XP is never consumed
coins_rule.source: memory.rs LevelingData::add_experience + test coins mirror total xp

correction.trigger: a wrong: correction is processed (main.rs App::get_brain)

game_exploration.also: GameMaster badge once 3 distinct games played

per_recorded_qa.note: a single question can therefore award XP on two paths (add_message + add_conversation); intentional economy pacing, see docs/knowledge.md §Known quirks
per_recorded_qa.trigger: every answered question that is recorded to history

streak_daily_bonus.also: StreakWarrior(7) badge + achievement at 7 days; StreakWarrior(30) at 30
streak_daily_bonus.trigger: user message while streak > 1 day (main.rs add_message)

rules: streak increments when last activity was exactly yesterday
streak resets to 1 after a fully missed calendar day
same-day activity leaves the streak unchanged
activity timestamps are stored as unix seconds in last_activity

teaching.also: awards the ⚡ Quick Learner path badge KnowledgeSeeker on first teach

topic_mastery.note: first time per topic only (repeat: 0 XP)

completion.detection: memory::parse_mission_completion matches win phrases; complete_mission_by_text matches board entries

completion.untracked: saying you beat something not on the board: +25 XP + celebration

missions.duplicate_rule: re-adding an active mission is refused ('already on our board')
missions.model: co-op missions: a title + game, done flag
missions.source: memory.rs Mission / parse_mission_completion / complete_mission_by_text + main.rs handlers

fallback_rules: if online mode fails (no key, bad model, network error, HTTP error) Rocket answers from the local brain and says why
Local mode never touches the network

buy_decoration_rules: equipping a decoration unequips every other decoration in the same category (one per category)
